title: agent-gate configuration
description: Configuration for @weerachai06/agent-gate, read from agent-gate.json at the repo root. Every field is optional.

$schema.description: URL or path of this schema. Used by editors for completion and validation; agent-gate ignores it.

maxOutputChars.description: Longest command output sent back to the agent. Lines that mention changed files and error lines are kept first; the rest is cut with a count of omitted lines.

rules.description: Checks on source files. They run after each Claude Code edit and again, on every changed file, when the agent finishes.

id.description: Short name of the rule, shown to the agent in front of each problem.

files.description: Globs, relative to the repo root, of the files this rule applies to.

ignore.description: Globs of files to skip, even when they match "files".

forbidImports.description: Modules that must not be imported. "fs" also matches "node:fs" and "fs/promises", but not "fsevents". Covers import, export ... from, require() and import(). Type-only imports are ignored.

forbidImportNames.description: Names that must not be imported from a module. Matches the original name, not the alias.

from.description: The module. Also matches its subpaths, so "react" matches "react/jsx-runtime".

names.description: Names or globs, for example "use*". "default" is the default import and "*" a namespace import.

forbidGlobals.description: Identifiers that must not be used. There is no scope analysis, so a local variable with the same name is reported too, and property accesses such as obj.fetch are not.

message.description: Shown to the agent with each problem. Quote the line from your CLAUDE.md so it reads the repo's own wording.

fix.description: How to fix a violation, shown after the message. One or two sentences; point to an example file. Costs tokens only when the rule is broken.

commands.description: Project commands that run when the agent finishes (Stop), in order, stopping at the first failure. They run only after every rule passes.

name.description: Short name of the command, shown to the agent when it fails.

run.description: The command as an argument list. There is no shell. A "{files}" argument expands to one argument per changed file, split across several runs when the list is long.

files.description: Run only when a changed file matches one of these globs. Without it, the command runs whenever any file changed.

timeoutSec.description: Seconds before the command is killed. A command that times out is a warning, not a block.

rules.message: Core must be pure. Move I/O to the shell.
